Without them, the businesses and everything else kept $6.93. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

oneTimers: Investment gains of $23,857M before tax ($18,750M after tax) were mostly locked in, not paper: after-tax realized gains on sales were $47.0B in the quarter — taxable gains were $59.6B before tax, mainly from trimming Apple — partly offset by a $28.2B after-tax fall in unrealized gains, much of it those same Apple gains leaving the unsold pile. The unrealized part can just as easily reverse next quarter.

No significant catastrophe events hit in the first six months of 2024, while a year ago they cost about $450M after tax in the first half. GEICO's pre-tax underwriting earnings jumped to $1,786M from $514M as its loss ratio fell to 74.1% from 84.3%.
Currency moves on foreign debt: revaluing Berkshire's non-dollar borrowings produced a gain of about $446M after tax inside the 'Other' operating earnings line, similar to a $465M gain a year ago.
otherDetail: Investment gains of $23,857M — mostly gains on Berkshire's stock portfolio, led by sales of Apple shares — plus $252M of equity-method earnings, less $150M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

takeaways.text: The businesses themselves earned $11.6B after tax, up from $10.0B a year ago — insurance underwriting nearly doubled to $2.3B as GEICO's loss ratio fell about 10 points, and insurance investment income rose to $3.3B on Treasury Bill yields.
takeaways.title: Operating earnings rose 15%

takeaways.text: Headline profit was $30.3B, down from $35.9B a year ago even though the businesses improved — investment gains were $23.9B before tax, less than last year's $33.1B. Berkshire sold roughly half its Apple stake: Apple was worth $84.2B at June 30, down from $174.3B at year-end.
takeaways.title: Selling Apple swelled the headline

takeaways.text: Cash, equivalents and Treasury Bills reached about $277B at June 30 — Berkshire received $97.1B from stock sales in the first six months and spent only $4.3B buying. Insurance float was about $169B.
takeaways.title: The cash pile set a record

verdict: Berkshire's operating earnings rose 15% to $11.6B as GEICO drove insurance underwriting to $2.3B, and $23.9B of pre-tax investment gains — mostly locked in by selling Apple stock — lifted headline profit to $30.3B.
